introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, slowly extend your left leg until it is straight and parallel to the ground.\n\nInhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.
name: OPEN CHAIN KNEE EXTENSION LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
Do this exercise slowly and don't use the impulsive force.
Don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.

introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, slowly extend your right leg until it is straight and parallel to the ground.\n\nInhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.
name: OPEN CHAIN KNEE EXTENSION RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
Do this exercise slowly and don't use the impulsive force.
Don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.

introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, slowly lift your left knee straight up. Inhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.
name: KNEE LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please do this exercise slowly and do not use the impulsive force.
Exhale as you lift your knee, and inhale as you lower it.
Please don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.
This exercise strengthens your hip flexors.

introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, slowly lift your right knee straight up. Inhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.
name: KNEE LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please do this exercise slowly and do not use the impulsive force.
Exhale as you lift your knee, and inhale as you lower it.
Please don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.
This exercise strengthens your hip flexors.

introduce:
Hold the chair back with your left hand for balance.

Exhale, slowly lift your right leg out to the right side as high as possible.

Inhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.
name: RIGHT LEG LATERAL RAISE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your core.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
Please keep your upper body still.
This exercise works the lateral muscles on your legs.

introduce:
Hold the chair back with your right hand for balance.

Exhale, slowly lift your left leg out to the left side as high as possible.

Inhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.
name: LEFT LEG LATERAL RAISE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your core.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
Please keep your upper body still.
This exercise works the lateral muscles on your legs.

introduce: Sit with your arms extended forward. Exhale, squeeze your glutes, press through your heels, and stand up tall.\n\nInhale, slowly lower your body and sit back down on the chair. Repeat.
name: CHAIR SQUATS

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If too easy for you, remove your chair.
You should feel your glutes burning.
This exercise can tone up your lower body.
This exercise targets your hips, thighs and glutes.

introduce: Sit upright. Extend your left leg in front of you with your heel on the ground and toes pointing up.\n\nReach both of your hands towards your toes. Hold this position, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: SEATED HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your knee straight during the stretch.
Please keep the other foot flat on the ground.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.
Breathe deeply and steadily.

introduce: Sit upright. Extend your right leg in front of you with your heel on the ground and toes pointing up.\n\nReach both of your hands towards your toes. Hold this position, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: SEATED HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your knee straight during the stretch.
Please keep the other foot flat on the ground.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.
Breathe deeply and steadily.

introduce:
Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Exhale, hinge forward from the hips, using your left hand to push your knee down toward the ground.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: CHAIR GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your back straight.
Please relax your hips.
Breathe regularly.
To make a deeper stretch, pull your crossed leg closer to your body.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and glutes and can reduce your lower back pain.

introduce:
Put your right ankle on your left knee.

Exhale, hinge forward from the hips, using your right hand to push your knee down toward the ground.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: CHAIR GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your back straight.
Please relax your hips.
Breathe regularly.
To make a deeper stretch, pull your crossed leg closer to your body.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and glutes and can reduce your lower back pain.

introduce: Sit upright. Inhale, lift your toes off the ground, rocking back onto your heels.\n\nExhale, rock forward, lifting your heels off the ground onto your toes. Repeat.
name: CHAIR HEEL TO TOE ROCK

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet parallel and your ankles stable.
Please pause at the top for a few seconds.
Inhale as you rock back, and exhale as you rock forward.
Please do it slowly.
This exercise is great for improving ankle mobility and balance.
